solution.title: Application Estate Monitoring, Reporting & Supportability (Microsoft Graph & Power BI)

products.name: Application Estate Monitoring, Reporting & Supportability (Microsoft Graph & Power BI) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build the monitoring, reporting & supportability layer over your Intune app estate: a fixed KPI set with healthy ranges, a delivery SLO, a scheduled Microsoft Graph → Power BI pipeline, a three-view dashboard, alerting, and an ownership/triage model. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop guessing whether your applications are actually being delivered

You can see whether one app installed on one device. You cannot see the estate: which apps fail most, whether failures cluster in one deployment ring, how far the fleet has drifted from the approved version, whether anyone uses what you license, or — when something breaks — who owns the number. Today that answer is a manual CSV pasted into a spreadsheet: different every time, stale the moment it's made, and silent when the failure rate doubles overnight. This package replaces that with a living monitoring, reporting, and supportability layer built on Microsoft Graph and Power BI.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin follows end to end — backed by five ready-to-run PowerShell scripts.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create (app registration, storage container, Power BI dataset, scheduled task, alert rule) is named and reused verbatim through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open consulting meter that runs well into the thousands per day; the pipeline itself is read-only and low-volume by design, so it stays cheap to operate. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with a hard trust gate: the export must match the Intune console before any number reaches a leader's screen.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the measurement model (delivery / velocity / currency / value), the App Estate KPI Set with healthy ranges, the app-delivery SLO and error budget, the five data sources (Graph, Intune reports, Log Analytics, Data Warehouse), the pipeline diagram, and the supportability model.
  • Requirements Guide — 11 requirements, each with Description / Why / Verify / Implement-if-missing: Intune roles, the export app registration, exact Graph scopes (delegated and application), Power BI Pro licensing, storage, Log Analytics + diagnostic settings, and the full US Government cloud endpoint table.
  • Implementation Guide — the exact ordered build: KPI/SLO sign-off, pilot scope, storage, a least-privilege export identity, the console trust gate, the Power BI dataset + three-view report (executive / operations / per-app drill-down), scheduled refresh, the nightly export task, Azure Monitor alerting, and the ownership + triage model.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — install-status extractor (Graph → CSV/JSON for Power BI), top-N failure report by app/ring, version-drift & patch-currency reporter, KPI-snapshot generator, and a scheduled-export bootstrap (app registration + least-privilege scopes + scheduled task). All target Commercial or US Government clouds via one parameter.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides — 10 pass/fail gates from “extractor authenticates” to “the supportability loop closes,” plus the pipeline's own failure modes (empty exports, console mismatch, refresh errors, unattended-auth, throttling, Government endpoints).

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the pipeline and the review cadence for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A trustworthy, automatically-refreshed picture of how well your applications are delivered, kept current, and used — alerting on the two conditions that can't wait, and wrapped in an ownership model so every red number lands on a named owner's queue with the evidence already attached.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices and rollouts — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 scripts (four read-only; the bootstrap makes changes and is -WhatIf capable), all with -Environment Global|USGov|USGovDoD:
    • APPRPT-Export-AppInstallStatus.ps1 — per-device install/detection status for every app → CSV/JSON for the Power BI dataset
    • APPRPT-Report-TopFailures.ps1 — rank the worst deployment failures by app and rate; flag anything above the 3% healthy range
    • APPRPT-Report-VersionDrift.ps1 — version histogram, drift %, and patch currency (n-1) for a named app; list outdated devices
    • APPRPT-Generate-KPISnapshot.ps1 — roll the estate into one KPI snapshot row with PASS/FAIL verdicts; append per run to build the trend
    • APPRPT-Bootstrap-ScheduledExport.ps1 — one-time setup of the read-only export identity + nightly scheduled task (default preview)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
